payload.objective: Continue zero-cost first-dollar opportunity sourcing and screening in parallel while the separate Reddit application remains held at Patrick's manual external-action boundary.
payload.scope: Fresh market and bounty discovery, source verification, screening, Vera-side pursue/reject decisions, and feasibility analysis. No application, bid, claim, comment, account action, spend, contract acceptance, or customer communication is authorized.
acceptance_criteria: The existing Reddit opportunity and hold remain untouched.
Stale, human-role-misrepresentation, track-record, paid-entry, or poor-economics candidates are rejected without Patrick involvement.
Promising lower-friction candidates remain in screening until enough evidence exists for a Vera-side decision.
No Patrick escalation occurs merely to research an opportunity.
